episode.title: Neutron Stars: A Cube Weighs MOUNT Everest

synopsis: A tiny fragment of neutron star matter packs the immense gravitational mass of Mount Everest into a microscopic cube in deep space.
narration: A single sugar-cube of neutron star matter weighs as much as Mount Everest on Earth. Compressed under unfathomable gravity, atomic nuclei collapse into an ultradense stellar fluid, packing millions of tons into a microscopic fragment drifting silently in deep space.

shots.prompt: A glowing ultra-dense neutron star spinning rapidly in the void, surrounded by a subtle gravitational lens distortion halo and brilliant blue magnetic field arcs, slow dolly forward.

Scale transition from the vast shadowed peak of Mount Everest fading into a glowing translucent floating microscopic cube of neutron matter, magnifying incredible intense blue density and gravitational warping.
Camera pulls back continuously as the glowing ultra-dense cube recedes into the dark starry cosmos, restoring the wide framing and rotation of the neutron star in space.

music: Dark solemn cosmic underscore driven by a precise low synth pulse, building into a heavy orchestral swelling bass drop at the moment of dense gravitational collapse, maintaining a steady rhythmic momentum before severing abruptly mid-phrase for a seamless transition.
